Preserve source calendar, case definition, ICD label, explicit zeros and missingness; never sum states, strata, weekly/monthly/annual or reporting systems.
records.primary_source_label: Mexico DGE Weekly Morbidity
records.provenance_note: Multiple registered series are not declared safely additive. The compatibility curve uses one representative series; inspect source_series for every retained definition.
records.source_labels: Mexico DGE Weekly Morbidity; Mexico WHO FluNet Weekly Respiratory Laboratory Surveillance; Mexico DGE Monthly Morbidity; Mexico DGE Annual Morbidity
